newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks close firmer, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks close firmer, consolidation seen.

text.p: Taiwan stocks closed slightly higher in quiet trade on Saturday and brokers expected a consolidation to continue next week.
The index ended up 8.66 points or 0.13 percent at 6,596.10. Turnover was T$36 billion in Saturday's two-hour session.
Computer shares led the gains, with Mitac International up T$1.2 to T$26.9 and First International rising T$1.1 to T$48.

"Companies with good profit outlooks, such as electronic and computer firms, will continue to attract buying, but there is no good news to boost overall sentiment," said Chen Han-chung, analyst of Yungli Securities.
Some brokers noted the high margin loans outstanding, which was at a record T$236.2 billion on Thursday, and saw possible selling in coming sessions.
"There could be some selling, but again there is no major good or bad news in the market at present that major movements in share prices are not likely in the near future," Chen said.
A 6,550-6,650 point trading range was seen for Monday.
